rationale: Three neutral metrics painted red, green, red (value and top stripe) with no delta, threshold or sign: the status colours are decoration, and a reader will read 'Sessions' as failing. Two accent fills, high contrast, so the strip scores 10. Proposed: red/green on a value or stripe must be paired with a signed delta, a threshold or a status word in the same tile.
folded: implemented as a measurable check; kind changed from gaming to defect
